shape: Next.js 16 App Router; single page (`/`); panels open over the surface.

/.description: The whole treasurer view — strip nav across the bottom, ticket + AI hero on top, panels open over.

planned_routes_track_1.purpose: audit trail viewer, policy history, override register, AI activity log

panels.shell: frontend/components/PanelShell.tsx — width 660px or 92% on narrow; owns scrim, escape, focus return

design_tokens.brand_partner_lockup: Fusion Practices + Oracle Partner (external decks only, not in-app palette)

formatting_rules: Money in short form: £800k, €10m, $21m, CHF 7.2m — never full digit strings in prose.
Percentages: perCent() helper, one decimal for rates (4.25%), whole for coverage (60% hedged).
Numbers use `num` tailwind class for tabular alignment.
No emojis in code output unless the user explicitly asks.

shared_helpers.perCent(bp): converts basis points to percentage string

shared_components.ConfigChip: rounded pill with label + value, used in PlannerModal's 'Investment principles in use' row

ui_conventions: One panel at a time — never stack two.
Modals block; panels dim the surface.
Refresh state after every write: page.tsx pattern is `load()` returning full StateResponse.
AI blocks always carry a caveat line — 'never predicts rates' / 'governance narration, not a market view'.
Every currency card shows the derivation: `X × N% − hedged = gap`.
